page_title: VIL 1-1 ALA | Villarreal v Alaves 22/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Jesus Gil Manzano is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Villarreal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+7' Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
90+6' The corner is swung in but Villarreal can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+5' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
90+4' Luis Garcia Plaza decides to make a substitution. Luis Rioja will be replaced by Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves).
90+3' The referee allows time for a substitution. Andoni Gorosabel will be replaced by Xeber Alkain (Alaves).
90+3' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ander Guevara as he is replaced by Rafa Marin (Alaves).
90+1' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
89' Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
88' Here's the change. Samu leaves the pitch and Kike Garcia (Alaves) comes on as a substitute.

87' Excellent touch by Ramon Terrats (Villarreal)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
87' Villarreal players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
86' Substitution. Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal) replaces Dani Parejo.
86' Alaves fail to score from a corner as Filip Jorgensen (Villarreal) leaps to collect the ball.
85' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Filip Jorgensen thwarts him with a nice save. The ball goes out of play. Alaves are awarded a corner kick.
83' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
82' The attendance for today's match is 17498.

80' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Antonio Sivera tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
79' Villarreal take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
77' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) replacing Alex Sola.
75' A brilliant cross into the box finds Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
75' Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) is unable to get a good contact on the ball from the corner and heads it well wide of the left post from close range.
75' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Villarreal.
75' The referee blows his whistle, Alaves are awarded a corner kick.
74' Pacheta has decided to substitute Kiko and he is replaced by Ramon Terrats (Villarreal).
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) is coming onto the pitch as Santi Comesana cannot continue after picking up an injury.
74' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
73' Samu (Alaves) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!

72' Luis Rioja (Alaves) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
69' 5:12 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
67' Luis Rioja (Alaves) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Filip Jorgensen to make a comfortable save.
65' 1 - 1 Goal! Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Antonio Sivera.
65' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) is going to take the penalty!

65' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Villarreal!
65' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Villarreal!

65' There's a break in play and referee Jesus Gil Manzano must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Villarreal using VAR. This could be interesting!
63' Jesus Gil Manzano interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves). A free kick is awarded to Villarreal.
62' Villarreal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
58' Jesus Gil Manzano shows the yellow card to Santi Comesana (Villarreal) for a heavy challenge.

56' Jon Guridi (Alaves) tries to get on the end of a cross in a crowded box, but under pressure his header from near the penalty spot slips well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
55' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) inside the box.
54' Pacheta prepares a substitution. Alfonso Pedraza is replaced by Alberto Moreno (Villarreal).
54' Aissa Mandi comes off the pitch to be replaced by Adria Altimira (Villarreal).
53' The Santi Comesana (Villarreal) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Jesus Gil Manzano rules it out for a foul.
52' A long pass finds Luis Rioja (Alaves), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the middle of the goal, but Filip Jorgensen reacts well to make a good save.
52' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
52' The resulting corner from Dani Parejo (Villarreal) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
51' The Villarreal players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
50' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal).
48' 0 - 1 Goal! Jon Guridi produces a great pass that finds Samu (Alaves) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a low shot into the back of the net. 0:1.
47' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
46' The whistle blows and Jesus Gil Manzano starts the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Kiko (Villarreal) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) takes the corner which is cleared.
44' Kiko (Villarreal) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Villarreal will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
43' The resulting free kick from Dani Parejo (Villarreal) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
43' A player from Alaves commits a rough challenge. Jesus Gil Manzano blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick has been awarded to Villarreal.

41' Luis Rioja (Alaves) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Filip Jorgensen pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going low into the middle of the target.
41' Jon Guridi (Alaves) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.

39' Ambitious effort from Ander Guevara (Alaves). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.

38' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. It's a free kick to Villarreal, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
36' Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jesus Gil Manzano didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
35' Jesus Gil Manzano shows a yellow card to Kiko (Villarreal), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
33' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Antonio Sivera (Alaves) is given a yellow card.
33' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Villarreal comes to nothing.
33' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag and Villarreal will take a corner.
31' Some patient build-up play from Villarreal as they look to unlock the defence.

29' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) attempts to test the goalkeeper after receiving a cross inside the penalty area. He hits the ball poorly and his shot goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
28' Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
27' The game is interrupted now, Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
26' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Jesus Gil Manzano due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Samu Omorodion (Alaves) and his team.
26' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
25' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
25' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
23' Jesus Gil Manzano shows a yellow card to Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) for a tough tackle.
22' Samu (Alaves) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
22' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

20' Samu (Alaves) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Filip Jorgensen pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The ball goes out of play. Alaves are awarded a corner kick.
20' The ball possession is 58:42.
18' Luis Rioja (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but Filip Jorgensen comes off his line to gather the ball.
16' Luis Rioja (Alaves) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
16' A quickly taken corner by Alaves.
16' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves).
14' Ander Guevara (Alaves) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jesus Gil Manzano ignores the protests.
9' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) sees a yellow card from Jesus Gil Manzano after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
6' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) heads on.
5' Luis Rioja (Alaves) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Villarreal will have the kick-off.
Jesus Gil Manzano got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
